newsitem.title: DOMINICAN REPUBLIC: Japanese official arrives in Dominican Republic.
newsitem.headline: Japanese official arrives in Dominican Republic.

text.p: Japanese Vice Foreign Minister Masahiko Komura arrived in the Dominican Republic on Thursday night, stopping en route to Havana, Cuba, where he was expected to discuss a resolution of the Peru hostage crisis.
Komura, who arrived on a chartered flight, was received at Santo Domingo's International Airport by Dominican Foreign Minister Eduardo Latorre. Komura did not speak to the press.

Komura was scheduled to meet with Dominican President Leonel Fernandez at midday on Friday in a discussion also expected to include the situation in Lima, where 72 people remained hostages to Marxist rebels who stormed the Japanese ambassador's residence during a reception on Dec. 17.
